paite: Huai lai a, nungzuite apunpun lai un, aniteng thilhawm uah Grik pau zang Juda meithaite limsak lou chi in Hebru pau zang Judate tung ah Grik Judate aphun uhi.
heading: Sagih Sehna

paite: Huan sawm-le-nihte'n nungzui mipite asamkhawm ua, "Pathian thugen tawpsan a dohkan a nek-tak ka bawl uh ahoih kei.
Huaiziak in unaute aw, na lak uah Kha leh pilna a dim mi minhoih ngen sagih tel un, amau hiai thil gel ding in ka bawl ding ua;
kou ahihleh thum leh thu nasem in ka om gige zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
Huai thu in mi tengteng akipaksak a; huchi in ginna leh Kha Siangthou a dim ngen, Stephen, Philip, Prokoras leh Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas leh Judate phungkai Antiok a mi Nikolas atel uhi.
Sawltakte ma ah hiai mite adingsak ua; amau athum ua, atung uah akhut uh anga uhi.
Huchi in Pathian thu ahong dalh zom zel a; Jerusalem ah nungzuite apungta mahmah ua; siampute lak ah leng mi tampi'n ginna lam ahong ngata uhi.
Huan Stephen, hehpihna leh thilhihtheihna in adim in, mi lak ah thillamdang leh chiamtehna thupite ahih zom zel hi.
heading: Stephen Matna

paite: Himahleh Kurini, Aleksandria leh Silisia gam leh Asia gam a kipan Juda pawl khat Salsuakte sinagog kichite leh mi khenkhat ahong kisa ua, Stephen hong kiselpih uhi.
Himahleh apilna leh agenpihpa Kha aselkhe thei kei uhi.
Huan mi khenkhat aguai ua; huai mite'n, "Mosi leh Pathian agensiat ka za uh," achi uhi.
Huan mite, upate leh laigelhmite atokthou ua, Stephen asual ua, aman ua, vaihawmte kiang ah api uhi.
Theihpih zuauthei bawlkhia in, amaute'n, “Hiai mi'n hiai mun siangthou leh Dan agense gige,
Nazaret Jesu'n hiai mun ahihse dia, Mosi in hon piak dante ahihlamdang ding chih, agen ka za uh," achi uhi.
Huan vaihawmte tengteng in Stephen a-ensal chiat ua, amel angel mel bang in amu uhi.
